referenceMethod: Local official logos were inspected visually; brand language was described in the prompts. No official logo was edited or generated inside the characters.

export.tool: @cf-wasm/photon 0.4.0 (existing project package, used only during asset export)
export.operation: Deterministic Lanczos3 resize to 192x192 and lossless WebP encoding; no generative edits, recoloring or vector tracing

states.neutral: Static original art plus one short greeting on mount; brand-specific sway or nod
states.listening: Attentive static tilt plus animated CSS audio bars only while recording
states.searching: Brand-specific subtle sway or lean plus CSS dots only during an actual search
states.complete: One short lift plus a CSS checkmark
states.reducedMotion: All animations disabled; the static art, listening tilt and status indicator remain
